description: Returns a watch_id + secret (shown once): we POST a signed webhook (MRL-Signature = HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + "." + body)) whenever a watched business gets a new or revised revenue figure. Paid via x402 (USDC on Base): $1 per business per 30 days (max $5), $5 for all; included with Builder/Team keys (X-API-Key). Unpaid call = free preview of the latest real changes + terms; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]. Example: {"slugs":["cursor"],"webhook_url":"https://example.com/hook"} -> free preview + terms for $1; the paid retry returns the watch.

webhook_url.description: https URL on a public host (port 443)

name: watch_revenue
title: Watch revenue moves (webhook, paid, x402)
